hero.name: Anastasia Ayivor
hero.tagline: Businesses shouldn't have to wait until something goes wrong to discover what they should have been doing all along.
hero.bio: Anastasia Ayivor is the Founder and CEO of Jojan One, an AI-powered LegalTech and RegTech platform built to help businesses understand their obligations, manage risk and demonstrate readiness.

paragraphs.text: With an academic background in law, including an LLB and an LLM in Commercial Law, and professional experience across regulatory reporting, compliance and business advisory, I have worked closely with organisations navigating practical challenges involving regulation, governance, contracts, risk and business operations.

Through this experience, I identified a recurring challenge: small and growing businesses are increasingly expected to manage sophisticated legal, regulatory and governance responsibilities without necessarily having dedicated legal, compliance or risk teams.
Jojan One was created to help close that gap by bringing compliance, risk, contracts, people, governance, data protection, business intelligence and evidence into one intelligent platform.
My vision is to develop Jojan One into internationally scalable business protection infrastructure that makes sophisticated compliance and risk intelligence more accessible to growing organisations.

items.heading: Compliance should be a business asset
items.body: Done well, compliance isn't a burden – it's proof that your business is well-run. We help you turn that proof into a competitive advantage.

items.heading: Clarity beats complexity
items.body: Most compliance tools make things more complicated. We obsess over making things simpler – without sacrificing accuracy or depth.

items.heading: Accessible to every organisation
items.body: The businesses that need compliance support the most are often the ones with the least access to it. That's the gap Jojan One was built to close.

connect.heading: Get in touch
connect.body: I'm always happy to hear from founders, operators, and anyone thinking seriously about how business protection can work better for their organisation.
